title: Hook up Goreleaser to publish to homebrew-cmdk
description:
Update `go/.goreleaser.yaml` to match the agenc pattern for Homebrew tap publishing.

Reference: `mieubrisse/agenc/.goreleaser.yaml`

Key changes needed:
- Add `token: "{{ .Env.HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN }}"` to the brews.repository config so goreleaser can push the formula to the tap repo
- Add `directory: Formula` to match the agenc convention
- Update repo name from `homebrew-tap` to `homebrew-cmdk`
- Add `dependencies` for fzf and fd (required runtime deps)
- Add `license` field
- Consider adding ldflags for version injection

Requires: A `HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN` GitHub personal access token (fine-grained, with contents:write on the homebrew-cmdk repo) stored as a repo secret on mieubrisse/cmdk.

title: Add Ctrl+T toggle to show/hide gitignored files in fzf
description:
While fzf is open, pressing Ctrl+T should toggle visibility of gitignored files (.env, node_modules contents, etc.). By default these are hidden by fd; toggling passes --no-ignore to fd.

Implementation approach:
- Add a '--no-ignore' or '--show-ignored' flag to 'cmdk list-files' that passes --no-ignore to fd
- Wire up fzf --bind for Ctrl+T to reload the file list with the toggled flag
- Consider adding a '-e' CLI flag to start with gitignored files visible (as PR #24 did)

Reference: PR #24 implemented this in shell scripts with toggle-state.sh and reload-with-toggle.sh.

title: Create release GitHub Action to run Goreleaser
description:
Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs Goreleaser on tag push, producing GitHub releases and updating the Homebrew formula.

Reference: `mieubrisse/agenc/.github/workflows/release.yml`

The workflow should:
- Trigger on `push.tags: v*`
- Set `permissions.contents: write`
- Checkout with `fetch-depth: 0` (goreleaser needs full history for changelog)
- Set up Go using `go-version-file: go.mod`
- Run goreleaser with `release --clean`
- Pass `GITHUB_TOKEN` and `HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN` secrets

Important: Since the Go code lives in `go/`, the workflow needs to either `cd go/` or set the working directory for the goreleaser step. Check whether goreleaser-action supports a `workdir` option, or whether the go-version-file path needs adjusting to `go/go.mod`.

Usage: After this is set up, releasing is just `git tag v0.1.0 && git push --tags`.

title: Add Ctrl+G toggle to filter fzf results to git-changed files only
description:
While fzf is open, pressing Ctrl+G should toggle between showing all files and showing only git-changed files (modified, staged, untracked). This is useful for developers working in repos who want to quickly jump to files they're actively editing.

Implementation approach:
- Add a 'git-files' listing mode to the listing package that uses 'git status --porcelain' and 'git diff --name-only' to find changed files
- Wire up fzf --bind for Ctrl+G to reload the file list by calling 'cmdk list-files --git-only' (or similar flag)
- Gracefully handle non-git directories (no-op or show a message)
- Deduplicate files that appear in both staged and unstaged changes

Reference: PR #24 implemented this in shell scripts with git-files.sh, git-toggle-state.sh, and reload-files.sh. We need the Go equivalent.

title: Create mieubrisse/homebrew-cmdk repo
description:
Create a new GitHub repo `mieubrisse/homebrew-cmdk` to serve as the Homebrew tap for cmdk.

Reference: `mieubrisse/homebrew-agenc` follows the same pattern — a repo containing just a `Formula/` directory and a `README.md`. Goreleaser auto-publishes the formula there on release.

Steps:
- Create the repo on GitHub (public, with a simple README)
- Goreleaser will manage the `Formula/` directory contents automatically
